resources.title: WorkOrder Pipeline Architecture Reference
resources.description: A one-page reference covering this capstone's real architecture from Lesson 2: the five-tool pipeline, the grain decision, why dw.FactWorkOrder is an accumulating snapshot, why its three date keys are a role-playing dimension, the Production.Location scope decision, the accumulating-snapshot load sequence, and the five-stop ripple pattern for any future schema change.

resources.title: WorkOrder Pipeline Validation Checks (SQL script)
resources.description: The four real validation queries from Lesson 10 — row-count parity across Production.WorkOrder, stg.WorkOrder, and dw.FactWorkOrder; orphaned-foreign-key checks against every dimension; the cross-tool scrap-rate agreement check; and the date-range check — bundled into one runnable .sql script, plus the commented-out ShiftKey check Lesson 11 adds after a schema change. Exactly the script Lesson 10's lab tells you to save and reuse.

resources.title: Resume Bullet Worksheet: The WorkOrder Capstone
resources.description: A fill-in worksheet applying Lesson 16's action-verb + tool + outcome structure to each of this capstone's four deliverables — the pipeline, the warehouse, the SSRS report, and the Power BI dashboard — with the lesson's own filled-in example bullets included for comparison, plus guidance on where this project belongs on a career-changer's resume.
